meta.title: Japanese study
meta.description: Adds a Japanese study entry to the left sidebar and a full graph page over this workspace's local grammar, word and example databases. Selecting a word connects the grammar points, example sentences and related words that actually exist in the data; selecting a grammar point connects its examples, near-synonym entries and component words. The Classification rail groups the stored tags into function, register, level and type facets. Search accepts Japanese, Chinese glosses and English. Read-only: no database is modified.
